name: SubWF 04C - Human in the Loop Escalation

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO tickets (ticket_number, customer_id, conversation_id, priority, status, reason)
VALUES (
  'TICK-' || floor(random() * 90000 + 10000)::text,
  '{{ $json.customer?.id || 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' }}',
  '{{ $json.conversation?.id || 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' }}',
  '{{ $json.ai_output?.sentiment === 'angry' ? 'urgent' : 'high' }}',
  'open',
  '{{ ($json.customer_message || 'Customer requested human support').replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
)
RETURNING ticket_number, priority, status, created_at;
=UPDATE conversations SET status = 'handed_off', current_intent = 'human_escalation' WHERE id = '{{ $('Execute Workflow Trigger').first().json.conversation?.id }}';
